execution_fixture.migration_state: WooPayments client plugin inactive; native runtime owner; Stripe test mode

verification.command: WCPAY_RUNTIME=native pnpm --dir plugins/woocommerce test:e2e:with-env woopayments-native --project=woopayments-native-provider --workers=1 --retries=0 --grep "(one signup-fee subscription checkout|one no-signup-fee subscription checkout|one free-trial signup)"
verification.summary: Passed 3/3 in 2.5 minutes with one worker and zero retries, on approval 2026-08-20-subscriptions-s1-s3-closure. S1 signup fee, S2 no signup fee and S3 free-trial setup plus its journaled renewal all green; lock directory ended with zero quarantine receipts and zero unresolved provider write attempts. S1 and S2 were re-run against the corrected line-item shape rather than the original fee-line one: WooCommerce Subscriptions raises the product's own price for the initial payment, so the parent order carries one line at USD 11.98 and no fee line. See the 2026-08-20 correction in FIDELITY-CLAIMS.md.

The full seven-case family does not pass and this packet closes none of the rows that depend on S4 to S7. S4's change-payment submission stalls: the click reaches native's handler, it takes the new-card branch and blocks the native submit, and its promise never settles - zero submission POSTs, no error in the shopper-facing error region, the form unblocked, the payment element frame unchanged between the card being typed and the submission, identical headed and headless across five reproductions, and no provider contact on any of them. Driving the same surface by hand works in all three of its states. The cause is unresolved. Because the family runs serially, S5 to S7 have never been attempted.
